Caribbean in the 1650s, seen from a little above, the houses standing

houses to the bottom of the picture, is wide empty packed earth with
cart ruts and scattered straw, lit by the lanterns and the moon, open
for two men to fight on. Nobody is in the street. Historical reenactment
photography, sharp focus, realistic. Style: one consistent look for the whole series, photographed like a
period film still of the 1660s Caribbean, natural warm light, gentle
film grain, muted rich colours with warm amber and deep teal tones,
moderate contrast, shallow depth of field, realistic textures, no text.
